# GfxMode3DWidth 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Display](Blitz3D-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GfxMode3DWidth:Int32 mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | Number of the mode, 1 to [CountGfxModes3D](CountGfxModes3D). |

**Returns:** The width in pixels.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

The width in pixels of a mode from the list of 3D modes. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no way to ask a 3D mode for its size, other than [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth) for the same number. A mode number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
